facts.fact: The government's "Zéro donnée à l'extérieur" chantier, one of the twelve digital-transformation chantiers to 2030, aims to host platforms and data on national territory, and the Prime Minister's half-year evaluation of 25 July 2026 reported it as under implementation.

The ministry reported 120 public platforms inventoried for hosting in the country, the two inaugurated data centres being the destination, with repatriation begun and targeted for completion before end-2026; the document counts no body as having moved.
